# S M Abdullah All Mehbub Sadik

> Paid Media Strategist & Growth Architect who runs Meta, TikTok and Google Ads for D2C and FMCG brands, and builds the websites and dashboards those ads point to. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working remotely with UK and EU brands. Also offers a white-label partner program for agencies that need extra hands on ads or web builds.

## Key facts

- $1.5M+ total ad spend managed across Meta, TikTok and Google Ads
- 1M+ results generated (purchases, leads and more)
- $1.48 average cost per result
- 4.5x–9x account-level ROAS, peak 9x
- 31 ad accounts managed, 1,400+ campaigns executed
- 3.5 years hands-on paid media experience, since January 2023
- Web development stack: Next.js, Supabase, built with Claude Code, deployed on Vercel
